lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters are visible posterior to the fifth gill slit, forming a semi-regular grid pattern with increased spacing in the posterior direction.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the primary horizontal spot rows, creating localized intensity maxima at the grid nodes on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient from high-luminance upper edges to shadowed lower margins.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Three distinct, elongated, pale filamentous structures are attached to and trailing from the posterior edge of the visible pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region anterior to the branchial slits exhibits a dense, non-linear cluster of high-luminance micro-spots that are significantly smaller than the blobs on the lateral flank.
